notes: Minerva S.A. (B3: BEEF3) — South American beef pure-play with operations in Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay, Argentina, Colombia, Australia. Aug 2024: closed acquisition of 16 plants from Marfrig (Brazil + Argentina + Chile + Uruguay) for R$7.5bn — transformative deal but elevated leverage. FY ends Dec 31. Net debt elevated post-Marfrig deal closing in 2024 (~R$15bn jump in net debt and capacity uplift ~50%).

periods.notes: FY21: Revenue R$26.9bn (+33%), EBITDA R$2.49bn (margin 9.2%) — China demand strong.
FY23: Revenue R$29.4bn (-1%), EBITDA R$2.49bn (margin 8.5%) — Brazilian cattle cycle pressure on Brazil ops, offset by Uruguay/Argentina.

FY24: Revenue R$38.4bn (+31% reflecting partial-year contribution from acquired Marfrig plants closed Aug 2024). EBITDA R$2.35bn (margin 6.1%) — integration costs + financial expenses on deal funding produced net loss R$360M. Net debt jumped to ~R$9.7bn. Leverage ~4.1x.
